scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @quiz/contracts && npm run build -w @quiz/game-engine && npm run build -w @quiz/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @quiz/api && npm run build -w @quiz/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web 'npm run dev -w @quiz/api' 'npm run dev -w @quiz/web'
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && vitest run packages/game-engine
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && vitest run tests/integration
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
